scene: hallway, one project room, lobby, kitchen and lounge layers, with 32 animated characters of which 6 walk
crispness: No intermediate colour on the edges of the one-pixel ruler and of one character at each of ZOOM_CANDIDATES = 2, 3, 4 on the owner's display scale.

rules.zoomLevels: ZOOM_LEVELS is the subset of ZOOM_CANDIDATES that passed threshold 5.
rules.tintLevels: TINT_LEVELS is the largest N in 2..5 whose measured first-load bytes, with N tint variants of every measured room layer, stay within threshold 3.
rules.verdict: The verdict is pass only when thresholds 1 to 4 hold, ZOOM_LEVELS is not empty and TINT_LEVELS is at least 2, otherwise fail.
